def _unpack_stack(scope, only_errors=True):
    """
    Unpack a scope chain into a sequence of (scope, spec, target, error, branches) tuples.
    
    Args:
        scope: The scope to unpack (typically LAST_CHILD_SCOPE from a finalized error)
        only_errors: If True, only include scopes with errors or their ancestors
    
    Yields:
        Tuples of (scope, spec, target, error, branches)
    """
    # Collect all scopes from current back to root
    scopes_list = []
    cur_scope = scope
    while cur_scope is not None:
        scopes_list.append(cur_scope)
        cur_scope = cur_scope.maps[1].get(UP) if len(cur_scope.maps) > 1 else None
        if cur_scope is scope:  # Avoid infinite loops
            break

                branches.append(child_scope)
